decisions.reason: The footer-code changes stated in message 59 are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The internal-header code changes stated in message 59 are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The exposure-level names stated in message 59 are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the report-detail identifiers do not otherwise change the variant set.
Correcting RR03 and RR04 report-detail identifiers does not change the candidate's RR01 page-two customer-facing copy.
The candidate's general header coverage, style, and information requirements remain unchanged; variant-specific header codes are owned by the separate header-code consistency Requirement.
The report-detail identifier corrections do not change the dashboard's fields, prominence, heading, or visibility requirements.
The identifier corrections do not alter the report's visual-quality standard, retained design direction, or cross-variant visual consistency.
The report-detail identifier corrections do not alter the content, format, or concision of the front-page result explanation.
Correcting fixed variant report identifiers does not change the requirement that report IDs and other customer-specific fields remain editable.
The general footer style, page coverage, and information fields remain unchanged; the variant-specific footer codes are already handled by the footer-code consistency Requirement.
The report-detail identifier corrections do not change the final-page warning's presence, message, visual treatment, or footer relationship.
The report-detail identifier corrections do not change the vehicle-group display format or prohibition on checkbox-style presentation.
